tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Ninja + MSVC)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

tasks.label: CMake: Build (Debug)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cmake --build build --config Debug

tasks.label: CMake: Build (Release)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cmake --build build --config Release
